goal: Allow IPC mining clients to submit and prefer an equal-work block in a single call
Eliminates race conditions against concurrent chain activations and saves extra RPC round-trips
reviewability: Needs rebase due to conflicts with master, but the logic is ready to review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections across five reviewers
Support for atomically submitting and preferring blocks in one IPC call (pablomartin4btc)
Endorsed because building on an own tip maximizes payouts (0xB10C, Sjors, ViniciusCestarii, johnnyasantoss)
Resolved objection regarding return status behavior for duplicate submissions (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it lets external miners atomically prefer equal-work submitted blocks over IPC
Avoids a race condition against concurrent chain activations while relaying their own blocks
